label: texo-384/encoder

provenance.summary: Texo's HGNetv2 encoder (4 stages, hidden 2048) as one NCHW WebNN graph, plus the decoder's cross-attention K/V for both layers computed here once per image: enc_to_dec_proj and k/v_proj folded into one 2048->384 projection each, emitted as 1x1 convs on the final [1,2048,12,12] map whose output reshapes for free into K^T per head.

source.model: Texo / FormulaNet as shipped in LatexGen public/models/texo (fp32 ONNX: encoder_model.onnx, decoder_model_merged.onnx)

recordedFrom.recorder: bench/webnn/ir-record.js (Proxy around MLGraphBuilder; shapes are the backend's)
recordedFrom.label: texo-encoder

folds: input channels 3 -> 1 (identical channels summed into stem1)
stem dynamic pads as constant pads (0,0,1,1) at 384x384
BatchNorm already folded into conv biases by the ONNX export
enc_to_dec_proj o k_proj / v_proj -> one 2048x384 weight per layer per side
cross-attention K emitted transposed ([1,16,24,144]) straight from the 1x1 conv output

note: One operand namespace: graph inputs keep their names, constants are k<N>, op results v<N>. Multi-output ops (split) list every result in `outputs`.
